items.text:
Like many others on this platform, I wish there was something between thumbs up and thumbs down.  While I like the bones that are here.  Starting out is brutal.  If you are going to play this game, do yourself a favor and download one of the mods that let you get rid of the randomness in the rogue like "career" text adventure that defines your character when they start out.  

So so much is not explained.  Figuring out just where to go to even sleep is not explained in any meaningful way.  You do start out in a bed, but by the time you need to sleep you will already be 4 hours in and juggling so much that you might have forgotten where you started.    Next, understand that you must maintain a certain level of air pressure in your ship or else you will go hypoxic.  It is not enough to just have the tanks full in your starter ship.   Final bit of advice, when expanding your starter ship, make sure there is floor build under a wall before removing the wall or you might just vent all your atmosphere out of your ship.  This is easily fixed by building the floor and then docking with a station and opening all your doors and airlock to standardize the pressure within your ship and the space station.

With that out of the way, the core game loop is just too frustrating currently without the "career" mods to ensure your character is not on the brink of death or bankruptcy right at the start.   There is a diamond of a core game loop here it is just very rough without mods.
items.text_zh:
和这个平台上的许多人一样，我希望在点赞和点踩之间能有个中间选项。虽然我喜欢这里现有的基础框架。但起步阶段简直残酷。如果你打算玩这款游戏，帮自己一个忙，下载一个模组，让你能摆脱那个定义你角色初始状态的roguelike“职业生涯”文字冒险中的随机性。

太多东西都没有解释。连到底该去哪里睡觉都没有以任何有意义的方式说明。你确实是在一张床上开始的，但等到你需要睡觉的时候，你已经玩了4个小时，手忙脚乱地应付着太多事情，可能已经忘了自己是从哪里开始的。接下来，要明白你必须在飞船里维持一定的气压水平，否则你会缺氧。仅仅让初始飞船里的气罐装满是不够的。最后一点建议，在扩建你的初始飞船时，确保在拆除墙壁之前先在墙下建好地板，否则你可能会把飞船里的所有空气都排出去。这很容易修复，先建好地板，然后与一个空间站对接，打开你所有的门和气闸，让飞船内和空间站内的气压标准化。

说完这些，目前的核心游戏循环在没有那些“职业生涯”模组来确保你的角色不会一开始就濒临死亡或破产的情况下，实在是太令人沮丧了。这里有一个钻石般的核心游戏循环，但没有模组的话它非常粗糙。

observations.description: 开局难度极高，角色容易濒死或破产
